entities.summary: Li Ronghao is a Chinese singer-songwriter and actor. Initially a music producer, he achieved breakout success as a singer with his debut album Model (2013), for which he won the Golden Melody Award for Best New Singer. From 2019 to 2022, he served as a coach on Sing! China for four seasons.
